At the [United States Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_United_States_Grand_Prix "2024 United States Grand Prix"), Verstappen took pole position for the sprint, ahead of Russell, Leclerc and Norris.[[165]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-172) At the race start, Verstappen maintained the race lead and won the sprint uncontested. Norris moved from fourth to second at the start, and held onto the position for much of the race before Sainz overtook Norris and maintained the position. Norris held onto third with Leclerc fourth.[[166]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-173) Norris took pole for the main race, ahead of Verstappen, Sainz and Leclerc.[[167]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-174) Norris and Verstappen retained first and second into the first corner, with Verstappen attempting to overtake Norris on the inside. Verstappen and Norris both ran wide at the corner, allowing Leclerc into the lead. Verstappen maintained second, with Sainz moving into third and Norris dropping to fourth. Through the first pit stops, Sainz successfully undercut Verstappen into second place, with Leclerc and Norris holding positions. Norris was able to close the gap to Verstappen and from lap 43 would start a battle for third place. Norris made it past Verstappen on lap 52, but did so after Verstappen had forced him wide at turn 12. Norris did not return the position, and received a time penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage. Leclerc took the race win, ahead of Sainz. Norris finished third on track, but dropped to fourth following the application of his penalty, with Verstappen taking third in his place.[[168]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-175) Following the race, Verstappen's championship lead increased to 57 points over Norris, His advantage over Leclerc was reduced to 79 points. McLaren's lead over Red Bull decreased to 40 points. Ferrari (in third) moved to within 8 points of second placed Red Bull.[[169]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-176)
At the [Mexico City Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Mexico_City_Grand_Prix "2024 Mexico City Grand Prix"), Sainz took pole position for the race, ahead of Verstappen and Norris.[[170]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-177) Sainz lost the lead to Verstappen at the race start, with Norris remaining third. Sainz retook the lead on lap nine, with Norris also attempting to overtake Verstappen. Norris and Verstappen both ran wide, allowing Leclerc to move into second. Verstappen would receive a time-penalty for forcing Norris off track, and received a second time-penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage in a separate incident. Verstappen served both his penalties at his pit stop, dropping him to fifteenth. Following the pit stop phase, Norris was able to close the gap to Leclerc in second; Norris was able to make his way past after Leclerc made a mistake and ran wide at the final corner. Norris then started to chase down Sainz, but was unable to catch him before the end of the race, with Sainz winning from Norris and Leclerc. Verstappen finished sixth.[[171]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-178) Following the race, Verstappen's Championship lead over Norris was cut to 47 points, with Leclerc an additional 24 points back. In the Constructors's Championship, McLaren remained in the lead with 566 points, Ferrari moved into second with 537 points and Red Bull dropped to third, on 512 points.[[172]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-179)
[![](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c5/2024-08-24_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_3346_by_Stepro.jpg/250px-2024-08-24_Motorsport%2C_Formel_1%2C_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_3346_by_Stepro.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:2024-08-24_Motorsport,_Formel_1,_Gro%C3%9Fer_Preis_der_Niederlande_2024_STP_3346_by_Stepro.jpg)The season would be the twelfth and final year for [Lewis Hamilton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lewis_Hamilton "Lewis Hamilton") at [Mercedes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_in_Formula_One "Mercedes-Benz in Formula One"), with whom he holds [several records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_career_achievements_by_Lewis_Hamilton#Records "List of career achievements by Lewis Hamilton") including most races, wins, and championships with a single constructor.
At the [São Paulo Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_S%C3%A3o_Paulo_Grand_Prix "2024 São Paulo Grand Prix"), Piastri took pole in sprint qualifying, with Norris second, Leclerc third, and Verstappen fourth.[[173]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-180) The top four maintained their positions at the start and across the opening laps, with the McLaren duo of Piastri and Norris pulling away from Leclerc and Verstappen. Lap 16 saw Verstappen overtake Leclerc for third, and start to close the gap to Norris in second. Piastri let Norris past into first on lap 22, he remained in first to win. Piastri had to defend second from Verstappen, and was able to hold the position to the end. Verstappen had finished third on track, but received a time penalty for a virtual safety car violation - this dropped him to fourth and promoted Leclerc in his place.[[174]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-181) Norris took pole position for the main race, ahead of Russell in second. [Yuki Tsunoda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yuki_Tsunoda "Yuki Tsunoda") qualified in third, the highest starting position ever for him and his team [RB](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RB_Formula_One_Team "RB Formula One Team"). Verstappen qualified 12th,[[175]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-182) but started the race in 17th, after a penalty for changing engine components was applied. The race was held in wet conditions. At the race start, Russell took the lead, with Norris slotting into second. Norris was able to stay close behind Russell. By lap 18, Russell led from Norris, Tsunoda, Ocon, Leclerc and Verstappen. Lap 25 saw Leclerc make a pitstop, the following laps saw Tsunoda (after being overtaken by Ocon), Russell and Norris making pitstops. Norris overtook Russell shortly afterwards. A red-flag was thrown on lap 32, due to heavy ran and a crash for [Franco Colapinto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franco_Colapinto "Franco Colapinto"). Under the red-flag, the entire field was allowed to change tyres. When the race resumed, it was Ocon who led, followed by Verstappen and Gasly (none of whom had made pitstops before the red flag) followed by Norris and Russell. Shortly after the race, Norris ran wide and Russell was able to retake fourth. Lap 43, after a safety car period, saw several changes at the front of the running order: Verstappen was able to overtake Ocon for the race lead, and Norris slid under braking and falls behind Leclerc and Piastri, Piastri soon let Norris back through. The order would remain unchanged until the race end with Verstappen winning from the Alpine pair of Ocon and Gasly. Norris finished sixth.[[176]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-183)[[177]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-184) Following the race, Verstappen increased him Championship advantage to 62 points over Norris and 86 over Leclerc. McLaren's lead over Ferrari was reduced to 36 points, the lead over Red Bull increased to 49 points.[[178]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-185)
Russell took pole position for the [2024 Las Vegas Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Las_Vegas_Grand_Prix "2024 Las Vegas Grand Prix"), ahead of Sainz and Gasly. Verstappen and Norris qualified fifth and sixth.[[179]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-186) The race start saw Russell stay in first, with Leclerc moving from fourth to second. Although Leclerc was initially able to stay close behind Russell, he soon lost positions to Sainz and Verstappen, with Gasly having dropped back. Through the first pit stop Russell maintained first, with Verstappen moving into second, followed by Sainz, Leclerc, Norris and Hamilton. Hamilton would overtake Norris before the second pit stop phase. Through the second pitstop phase, Hamilton was able to undercut both Ferraris (Leclerc and Sainz) and overtake Verstappen on track to run in second behind Russell. The closing laps saw Hamilton close to the gap to Russell, but not by enough to take the lead, and saw Verstappen drop behind both Ferraris. Norris finished sixth. The result made 2024 the first season in which seven (or more) drivers were able to win multiple Grands Prix.[[180]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Kelly2024-1-187) The result saw Verstappen increase his Championship lead to 63 points. With Norris able to score a maximum of 60 point across the remaining rounds,[[181]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-188) the result was enough for Verstappen to claim the Drivers's Championship, his fourth consecutively.[[182]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-formula1.com-189) Leclerc moved to with 21 points of Norris for second. In the Constructors' Championship, McLaren's lead over Ferrari was cut to 24 points, and the lead over Red Bull increased to 53.[[183]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-190)
Norris took pole position for the final sprint of the season, at the [Qatar Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Qatar_Grand_Prix "2024 Qatar Grand Prix"), ahead of Russell and Piastri.[[184]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-191) Norris held the lead at the race start, with Piastri making his way past Russell into third. Piastri and Russell would spend most of the sprint race fighting for positions, with Piastri holding the position throughout. In the final corner, Norris let Piastri past to take the sprint win, with Norris finishing in second and Russell third.[[185]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-192) Verstappen set the fastest time in qualifying, ahead of Russell and Norris. Verstappen would, however, take a one-place grid penalty, promoting Russell to pole position in his place.[[186]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-QAT_quali-193) The opening lap of the race saw both Verstappen and Norris move past Russell into first and second, with Leclerc and Piastri fourth and fifth. Piastri would make his way past Leclerc on lap five and would soon close the gap to Russell, with Leclerc remaining close behind. Russell would be the first of the front runners to make a pit stop. A safety car was called on 35, to remove debris, which saw the remaining leaders make their first pit stops and Russell his second. Following these second pit stops it was Verstappen who led, from Norris, Leclerc and Piastri. The safety car restart saw Norris challenge Verstappen and Piastri challenge Leclerc, although no positions were exchanged. Norris would drop out of second, following a penalty for failing to observe yellow flags, allow Verstappen to win the race ahead of Leclerc and Piastri. Russell finished fourth and Norris tenth.[[187]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-194)[[188]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-195) Following the race, Verstappen's Championship lead increased to 80 points. Leclerc closed to within 8 points of Norris in second. Ferrari closed the gap to leaders McLaren to 21 points. Red Bull remained third and dropped out of contention for the Constructors' Championship, being 59 points behind with 44 still available. Red Bull were still in contention to take second place from Ferrari.[[189]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-196)[[190]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-197)
Pole position at the season-ending [Abu Dhabi Grand Prix](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Abu_Dhabi_Grand_Prix "2024 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix") was taken by Norris ahead of Piastri and Sainz.[[191]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-198) Leclerc started 19th. Norris retained the lead at the start. Piastri and Verstappen collided at the opening corner - a collision for which Verstappen was penalised - which dropped both drivers down the field. Leclerc made up 11 positions at the start to move into eighth. Leclerc would continue to make up positions. After the first pit stop phase, Norris held the race lead from Sainz, with Leclerc in third. The order of the top three remained stable until the race end with Norris taking the final win of the season. Behind the Ferraris, Hamilton, who started 16th, beat Russell to fourth with Verstappen sixth. Piastri finished tenth. The result was enough for McLaren to win the Constructor's Championship, their first since [1998](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1998_Formula_One_World_Championship "1998 Formula One World Championship"), with 666 points with Ferrari in second on 652 and Red Bull on 589. In the Drivers's Championship, Verstappen finished on 437 points, with Norris second on 374 and Leclerc third on 356.[[192]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-199)[[193]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-200)
### Post-season analysis
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2024_Formula_One_World_Championship&action=edit&section=25 "Edit section: Post-season analysis")]
Following the season, Verstappen was ranked as the best performing driver by a variety of pundits. He was praised for being consistently the best performing driver despite not having the best car.[[194]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-201)[[195]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-202) Perez described his own season as "a very, very difficult year",[[196]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-203) and Alasdair Hooper described his results as "stark reading".[[197]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Hooper1-204) Across the 24 rounds, Perez only beat Verstappen in one race - when Verstappen retired from the Australian Grand Prix. Perez secured four podiums (compared to Verstappen's 14) and failed to finish in the top 5 across the final 14 races, finishing the season in 8th.[[197]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Hooper1-204) Following the season's conclusion, Perez and Red Bull "reached an agreement to part ways", despite Perez having a contract to race with Red Bull for two additional years.[[198]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-205) Red Bull themselves started the year with the fastest car. Later in the year, they were not always the fastest car, but remained competitive throughout. Whilst Red Bull failed to win the constructor title, this was attributed mostly to Perez's lack of competitiveness.[[199]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Collantine2024-1-206)[[197]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Hooper1-204) Verstappen's title made him only third drivers' champion after [Keke Rosberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keke_Rosberg "Keke Rosberg") in [1982](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1982_Formula_One_World_Championship "1982 Formula One World Championship") and [Nelson Piquet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nelson_Piquet "Nelson Piquet") in [1983](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1983_Formula_One_World_Championship "1983 Formula One World Championship") to win the drivers' championship with a team that finished 3rd or lower in the constructors' championship, and the second driver after Piquet to win the drivers' championship in a team that did not become constructors' champions on two or more occasions.[[200]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-207)
Whilst McLaren started the year with the third fastest car, before an upgrade at the Miami Grand Prix (round 6) moved them to the fastest car, on average. Both Piastri and Norris were identified as having breakthrough seasons and were both noted for their consistency in helping McLaren achieve the Constructor's Championship, although both drivers and the team were also noted for making mistakes and having inexperience fighting for the championships.[[201]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Hughes1-208)[[202]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-209)[[203]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Elson1-210)[[204]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Website-1-211) Ferrari were praised for taking a "huge" step forward for the 2024 season as they challenged for the Constructor's Championship and claimed their highest win tally since 2018. In his end of season driver rankings, James Elson identified that Leclerc and Sainz both had their best seasons to date and both drivers were praised for their consistency.[[203]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Elson1-210)[[205]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-212) Mercedes start to the season was described as "troubled", with Hamilton describing the start to his season as the "worst" of his career. Though Mercedes were able to win a number of races in the middle part of the season, and one at the end, they were inconsistent overall. Russell was praised for outperforming teammate Hamilton. Hamilton was self critical of his results, particularly in qualifying.[[201]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Hughes1-208)[[206]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-213)[[204]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Website-1-211)[[203]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Elson1-210)
Aston Martin's season was described as being a season "significantly below expectations" where they failed to successfully build on their success in the [2023 season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Formula_One_World_Championship "2023 Formula One World Championship"), and where they suffered in a dip in performance at the end of the year. The majority of Aston Martin's points came at the beginning of the year, and they scored significantly less points than in 2023. Alonso was praised for delivering some strong performances and Stroll was criticised for underperforming across the year.[[199]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Collantine2024-1-206)[[207]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-214)[[208]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-215)[[203]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Elson1-210) With Alpine starting the season as the slowest team, and having a double podium in the 21st of 24 rounds (which saw them move from ninth to sixth in the Championship), Alpine were praised for their turnaround during the season, although race fans noted that sixth did not accurately reflect the pace of the Alpine over the season, with analysis showing them as having the eighth fastest car on average.[[209]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-216)[[199]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Collantine2024-1-206) Although a race-by-race head-to-head analysis put Ocon and Gasly almost level, Gasly scored almost two-thirds of the team's points, with Gasly praised for strong performances across the year and Ocon criticised for being too aggressive and being off the pace.[[203]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-Elson1-210) Haas's season was described as promising. In a year where they had a series of personnel changes, including a new team principal, they had effective in-season car upgrades and scored consistent points. Hulkenberg comfortably outperformed Magnussen over the course of the year, although both scored high placed-finishes across the season.[[210]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-217) RB's season was described as having "flashes of potential". Tsunoda was praised for his improvement on the previous year. Whilst Daniel Ricciardo was able to produce some strong performances, these were not consistent, which lead to him being replaced by Lawson mid-way through the season.[[211]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-218)[[212]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-219) Williams's season was seen described as a challenging one, but with plenty to be optimistic about: the team falling to ninth in the constructors' championship (from seventh in 2023), a mid-season driver swap and several major accidents, but the team making steps forward off track, with 2024 being seen as a rebuilding year. Albon was able to outperform Sargeant before the latter was replaced. Sargeant's replacement was more competitive, gaining praise for being able to challenge Albon regularly.[[213]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-220) Kick Sauber's season saw one points finish, eighth in the penultimate round. The season was described as "draining" and "hugely disappointing" with the team in "survival mode".[[214]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-221)

### Scoring system
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2024_Formula_One_World_Championship&action=edit&section=28 "Edit section: Scoring system")]
Further information: [List of Formula One World Championship points scoring systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Formula_One_World_Championship_points_scoring_systems "List of Formula One World Championship points scoring systems")
Points were awarded to the top ten classified drivers, the driver who set the fastest lap during the Grand Prix (only if they finished in top ten), and the top eight of the [sprint](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Formula_One_racing#Sprint "Formula One racing").[[2.3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-231) In the case of a tie on points, a countback system was used where the driver with the most Grand Prix wins is ranked higher. If the number of wins was identical, then the number of second places was considered, and so on.[[2.4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-232) Points were awarded using the following system:  
| Position  |  1st   |  2nd   |  3rd   |  4th   |  5th   |  6th   |  7th   |  8th   |  9th   |  10th   | [FL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fastest_lap "Fastest lap")  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| Race  | 25  | 18  | 15  | 12  | 10  | 8  | 6  | 4  | 2  | 1  | 1  |  
| Sprint[[f]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-sprint_locations-222)  | 8  | 7  | 6  | 5  | 4  | 3  | 2  | 1  |   |  
| Source:[[2.3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Formula_One_World_Championship#cite_note-231)  |
